_meta: DRAFT: machine-drafted; requires native-speaker review before release (P4-UX-01).
about_attribution: Vizulla yubakiye ku mushinga wa Chromium ufite isoko rifunguye (Blink na V8).
agent_goal_placeholder: Fata ameza y'abantu 2 kuri restaurant-x.rw, ku wa Gatanu saa 19:00
agent_grant_for: Koresha konti yanjye ninjiyemo kuri {origin} mu minota {minutes}
agent_hint_stage_a: Ikorera mu isesiyo yihariye (nta cookies cyangwa konti), iguma ku mbuga wemeye, kandi ntijya yohereza cyangwa ngo yishyure.
agent_hint_stage_b: Ikorera ku mbuga wemeye. Amakuru yawe bwite n'igikorwa cyose cyohereza cyangwa cyishyura bibanza kwemezwa nawe.
agent_injection_body: Iyi paji irimo inyandiko isa n'amabwiriza agenewe intumwa: “{excerpt}”. Intumwa izakomeza gukora gusa ibyo igenamigambi ryawe ryemera.
agent_injection_stopped: Byahagaze kubera ibiri kuri paji biteye amakenga.
agent_injection_title: Ibiri kuri iyi paji biteye amakenga
agent_isolated_note: Isesiyo yihariye: intumwa ntibona cookies zawe, konti zawe, cyangwa andi matabu.
agent_log_desc: Ibyo intumwa yabonye byose, buri gikorwa yasabye, ibyo mushakisha yafashe, n'ibyo wemeje. Bibikwa iminsi 30.
agent_new_origin_body: Uru rubuga ntiruri mu igenamigambi wemeje. Intumwa ishobora gukomeza ari uko ubyemeye.
agent_off_ai: Fungura AI mu Igenamiterere kugira ngo ukoreshe intumwa.
agent_off_optin: Injira muri gahunda y'igerageza mu Igenamiterere → Intumwa.
agent_off_stale: Intumwa yazimijwe kuko iyi verisiyo ishaje. Vugurura Vizulla kugira ngo uyikoreshe.
agent_profile_note: Bibitswe mu ibanga kuri iki gikoresho. Moderi y'intumwa ntijya ibona aya makuru: ikoresha ibiyasimbura, Vizulla ikabyuzuza nyuma yo kubyemeza.
agent_rejected: Byahagaze: mushakisha yabujije igikorwa kiri hanze y'igenamigambi ryawe ({reason}).
agent_sign_in_yourself: Iyi paji irasaba kwinjira. Intumwa ntijya ikoresha amagambobanga: injira ubwawe, hanyuma ukomeze.
agent_values_label: Amakuru intumwa ishobora kwandika (iyavuga ku izina ryayo gusa, ntibona ibindi byawe)
ai_composer_hint: Ibisubizo bishingiye kuri iyi paji gusa. Kanda Enter wohereze.
ai_disclosure_declined: Ntibyoherejwe. Nta kintu cyavuye ku gikoresho cyawe.
ai_empty_body: Yisobanure muri make, cyangwa ubaze ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose. Buri gisubizo kigaragaza aho cyakuwe.
ai_err_auth: Utanga serivisi yanze urufunguzo rwa API. Rugenzure mu Igenamiterere.
ai_err_empty_page: Nta nyandiko isomeka iri kuri iyi paji.
ai_err_internal_page: Umufasha ntasoma paji za Vizulla ubwayo. Fungura urubuga cyangwa PDF.
ai_err_network: Ntibyashobotse kugera ku utanga serivisi ya AI. Genzura interineti yawe.
ai_err_no_key: Ongeraho urufunguzo rwa API rwa {provider} mu Igenamiterere → AI.
ai_err_quota: Wageze ku mupaka w'ubuntu w'uyu munsi. Ongera ugerageze ejo cyangwa ukoreshe urufunguzo rwawe.
ai_err_refused: Iyi paji isa n'irimo amakuru y'ibanga kandi nta moderi iri kuri iki gikoresho, bityo nta kintu cyoherejwe.
ai_err_scanned_pdf: Iyi PDF ni ifoto yasikanywe idafite inyandiko. Gusoma inyandiko mu mafoto (OCR) ntibirashoboka.
ai_mode_byo_desc: Koresha Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, cyangwa seriveri yo kuri mudasobwa ihuye na OpenAI, ukoresheje urufunguzo rwawe.
ai_mode_cloud_desc: Binyuze kuri Vizulla Gateway. Nta konti ikenewe. Ibibazo ntibibikwa na rimwe.
ai_mode_local_desc: Bikorerwa kuri iyi mudasobwa. Nta kintu kiva ku gikoresho cyawe.
ai_mode_off_desc: Nta serivisi ya AI ikora na busa.
ai_off_panel: AI yazimijwe. Yifungure mu Igenamiterere kugira ngo uvuge muri make paji kandi ubaze ibibazo.
ai_partially_sourced: Bifite amasoko make: genzura ibice byavuzwe
archive_clear_confirm: Gusiba amatabu yose ari mu bubiko?
archive_desc: Amatabu umaze igihe udakoresha abikwa hano mu gihe cy'iminsi {days}.
bookmarks_empty: Nta byo urabika. Kanda Ctrl/⌘+D kuri paji kugira ngo uyibike.
cb_placeholder_long: Shakisha, wandike aderesi, cyangwa wandike > ku mabwiriza
clear_data_confirm: Gusiba amateka, cookies n'amadosiye yabitswe by'agateganyo? Uzasohoka ku mbuga nyinshi.
clear_history_body: Ibi bisiba amateka yawe yo gushakisha kuri iki gikoresho. Imyanya, ibyafatishijwe n'ibyo wabitse biragumaho.
cmd_shields_toggle: Fungura cyangwa uzimye Shields kuri uru rubuga
cmd_tab_mute: Cecekesha cyangwa ugarure ijwi rya tabu

disclosure_point_local: Ushobora guhindukira kuri AI yo kuri iki gikoresho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose mu Igenamiterere.
disclosure_point_retention: Vizulla Gateway ntibika ibibazo cyangwa ibisubizo. Abandi batanga serivisi ukoresha bakurikiza amategeko yabo.
disclosure_point_what: Hoherezwa gusa inyandiko isomeka y'iyi paji n'ikibazo cyawe: nta cookies, amagambobanga, cyangwa andi matabu.
err_cert: Icyemezo cy'umutekano cy'uru rubuga ntikemewe, bityo Vizulla yahagaritse ihuza kugira ngo irinde amakuru yawe.
err_internet_disconnected: Nta interineti ufite. Genzura ihuza ryawe.
flags_warning: Ibi bice biracyageragezwa. Kubihindura bishobora gutuma Vizulla idakora neza.
group_ai_none: Nta matsinda agaragara muri aya matabu
import_extensions_hint: Ibyongerwaho (extensions) ntibikopororwa. Ongera ubishyireho uvanye muri Chrome Web Store.
import_none: Nta yindi mushakisha yabonetse kuri iyi mudasobwa.
import_passwords_delete_csv: Siba dosiye ya CSV ubu: irimo amagambobanga yawe adahishe.
import_passwords_hint: Amagambobanga: sohora dosiye ya CSV muri mushakisha yawe ya kera, hanyuma uyizane muri Amagambobanga.
memory_cant_save: Iyi paji ntishobora kubikwa mu Bwibuke (ni iy'ibanga, irimo amakuru akomeye, cyangwa yakuwemo).
memory_empty_off: Ubwibuke burazimije. Bufungure kugira ngo uzabone paji nyuma ukurikije ibyo zavugaga.
memory_empty_on: Nta kirabikwa. Paji zishyirwa ku rutonde iyo mudasobwa yawe idakoreshwa.
memory_search: Shakisha ibyo wabonye: “isuzuma rya mudasobwa ryo ejo”
memory_wipe_confirm: Gusiba ibiri mu Bwibuke byose? Ntibishobora gusubizwa.
nl_confirm_body: Wabisabye mu magambo yawe. Vizulla yabihuje n'iri bwiriza, rihindura amakuru yawe.
notes_empty: Nta nyandiko uragira. Hitamo amagambo kuri paji uhitemo “Bika mu Nyandiko”.
ob_ai_body: Ni wowe uhitamo aho amakuru yawe ajya. Ushobora kubihindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
ob_done_body: Kanda Ctrl/⌘+K igihe icyo ari cyo cyose kugira ngo ushakishe, ufungure amatabu, cyangwa ukoreshe amabwiriza. Imyanya itandukanya akazi n'ubuzima bwite.
ob_import_body: Zana ibyo wabitse n'amateka uvanye mu yindi mushakisha. Nta kintu cyoherezwa kuri interineti.
ob_layout_body: Amatabu ahagaze aha umwanya imitwe miremire. Ushobora kubihindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
ob_layout_horizontal: Amatabu hejuru, nko muri mushakisha isanzwe.
ob_welcome_body: Mushakisha ituje kandi irinda ibanga, ifite umufasha musomana paji kandi akakwereka aho yakuye amakuru.
perm_clipboard_read: Kubona inyandiko n'amafoto biri mu bubiko bw'agateganyo
perm_openExternal: Gufungura porogaramu iri kuri mudasobwa yawe
privacy_ai_sub: Buri busabe: urubuga, ingano y'inyandiko, n'aho bwakorewe. Bibikwa iminsi {days}. Ibikubiyemo ntibijya bibikwa.
privacy_nothing_yet: Nta kirahagarikwa. Komeza ushakishe gato hanyuma ugaruke.
pw_breached: Amagambobanga yawe {count} yagaragaye mu makuru yamenetse. Yahindure.
pw_csv_help: Chrome: Igenamiterere → Amagambobanga → Sohora. Firefox: Amagambobanga → ⋯ → Sohora. Mu igenzura, intangiriro ya hash y'inyuguti 5 ni yo yonyine iva ku gikoresho cyawe.
pw_desc: Abitswe mu ibanga kuri iki gikoresho hakoreshejwe urufunguzo rubikwa n'ububiko bw'imfunguzo bwa sisitemu yawe.
pw_no_breaches: Nta jambobanga ryawe ryabonetse mu makuru yamenetse azwi.
reader_expired: Uburyo bwo gusoma bwarangiye. Subira inyuma ubufungure bundi bushya.
security_insecure: Nta mutekano: amakuru wohereza ashobora gusomwa n'abandi
set_3p_cookies_desc: Ibuza imbuga udasura kugukurikirana ku mbuga zitandukanye.
set_accent_desc: Imyanya ikoresha ibara ryayo iyo uyirimo.
set_agent_grant_desc: Igihe intumwa ishobora gukoresha konti winjiyemo ku rubuga rumwe (Icyiciro B).
set_agent_tester_desc: Intumwa iracyageragezwa. Ikorera mu isesiyo yihariye kandi ibaza mbere y'igikorwa cyose gikomeye.
set_ai_disclosures: Imbuga wemereye gukoresha AI yo mu gicu
set_ai_disclosures_none: Nta zo. Uzabazwa ubwa mbere kuri buri rubuga.
set_ai_save_desc: Bizimije: ibiganiro birasibangana iyo ufunze tabu.
set_archive_desc: Amatabu adafatishijwe umaze igihe udafungura ajya mu bubiko. Ushobora kubisubiza igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
set_classic_desc: Amatabu hejuru, umurongo wa aderesi n'uw'ibyo wabitse bisanzwe, umufasha uhishe.
set_clear_data_desc: Amateka, cookies n'amakuru y'imbuga, amadosiye abitswe by'agateganyo.
set_compat_url_desc: Ya Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, cyangwa indi seriveri yo kuri mudasobwa. Ibisabwa kuri localhost bifatwa nk'ibikorerwa kuri iki gikoresho.
set_cookie_banners_desc: Yanga mu buryo bwikora cookies zitari ngombwa aho bishoboka.
set_crash_desc: Bizimije ubusanzwe. Raporo ntizirimo aderesi cyangwa ibiri kuri paji.
set_default_no: Vizulla si yo mushakisha yawe y'ibanze.
set_default_yes: Vizulla ni yo mushakisha yawe y'ibanze.
set_doh_desc: Ihisha mu ibanga ishakisha rya aderesi z'imbuga (DNS over HTTPS).
set_fingerprinting_desc: Yongera urusaku ruto rutunguranye ku bisomwa bya canvas, amajwi na WebGL kugira ngo imbuga zitakumenya.
set_gateway_desc: Vizulla AI Gateway. Yihindure gusa mu igerageza cyangwa mu ikoreshwa ry'akarere.
set_https_first_desc: Ihindura ihuza rikajya kuri HTTPS, igasubira inyuma gusa iyo urubuga rutabishyigikiye.
set_keys_note: Imfunguzo zibitswe mu ibanga hakoreshejwe {where}. Ntizijya zigera ku mapaji y'urubuga cyangwa ku gace k'umufasha.
set_layout_desc: Amatabu ahagaze ku ruhande, cyangwa amatabu hejuru.
set_memory_battery_desc: Ubusanzwe, paji zishyirwa ku rutonde gusa iyo mudasobwa icometse ku muriro kandi idakoreshwa.
set_memory_desc: Ibuka paji usura kugira ngo uzazibone nyuma ukurikije ibyo zavugaga. Birinzwe mu ibanga, kuri iki gikoresho gusa.
set_memory_saver_desc: Amatabu ari inyuma arekura memori, akongera gufunguka iyo uyafunguye. 0 = nta na rimwe.
set_restore_desc: Ongera ufungure Imyanya n'amatabu byawe aho wari ugeze.
set_search_engine_desc: Ikoreshwa mu gushakisha mu Murongo w'amabwiriza.
set_shields_desc: Ihagarika amatangazo n'abakurikirana ku mbuga zose.
set_telemetry_desc: Bizimije ubusanzwe. Imibare rusange gusa, nta aderesi cyangwa ibikubiyemo.
shields_breakage_hint: Niba urubuga rugaragara nabi, zimya Shields kuri rwo.
space_delete_body: Amatabu yawo azajya mu bubiko bw'undi Mwanya, ku buryo uzashobora kuyagarura.
sync_code_desc: Andika iyi kode ku kindi gikoresho cyawe. Uwo ari we wese uyifite ashobora kwinjira, bityo uyigire ibanga. Utayifite, amakuru yawe ntashobora kugarurwa.
sync_desc: Birinzwe mu ibanga kuva ku mpera kugeza ku yindi. Seriveri ibona gusa inyandiko zihishe.
sync_e2ee_note: Birinzwe mu ibanga kuri iki gikoresho hakoreshejwe urufunguzo rukomoka kuri kode yawe yo guhuza.
sync_enter_code: Andika kode yo guhuza yo ku kindi gikoresho cyawe
toast_focus: Kwibanda: amatabu {count} yo mu yindi Myanya asinziriye
toast_nothing_to_archive: Nta matabu adakoreshwa yo gushyira mu bubiko
toast_split_needs_tab: Fungura indi tabu kugira ngo ukoreshe idirishya rigabanyije
upd_manual: Ivugurura ryakuruwe. Rifungure kugira ngo urangize kurishyiraho.
settings_updates_auto_desc: Ibaza GitHub niba hari verisiyo nshya mu itangira na nyuma ya buri masaha make. Nta makuru akwerekeyeho yoherezwa.
set_custom_engine_desc: Urubuga urwo ari rwo rwose: komeka aderesi yarwo yo gushakisha ushyire %s aho amagambo ajya.
set_custom_engine_invalid: Koresha aderesi ya https:// irimo %s inshuro imwe gusa.
pm_empty_body: Vizulla igusaba kubika ijambobanga ryawe iyo winjiye ku rubuga.
pm_compromised_desc: Yabonetse mu makuru yamenetse. Banza uyahindure.
pm_offer_save_desc: Baza nyuma yo kwinjira ku rubuga. Ntibikorwa mu madirishya y'ibanga.
pm_export_desc: Dosiye ya CSV izindi porogaramu z'amagambobanga zishobora gusoma. Uwo ari we wese ufite iyi dosiye ashobora kubona amagambobanga yawe.
pm_never_saved_none: Imbuga uhitiyemo “Oya kuri uru rubuga” zigaragara hano.
profile_subtitle: Buri porofayili igira amatabu yayo, amateka, amagambobanga n'igenamiterere byayo.
profile_delete_confirm: Gusiba {name} n'amakuru yayo yose kuri iki gikoresho?
